title: Choose the visual world for JK Plumbing
question: Previews are on each card (desktop and phone, built in code with JK's real logo, photos and number). The roll assigned the sewer service diagram. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Sewer Service Diagram
options.lineage: NSW sewer service diagrams and hydraulic drawings
options.thesis: The page is drawn as the plumbing plan of your own house: tap where it's playing up, then call.
materials: real job photos pinned as details
options.viewport: A cut-away Macarthur house in hydraulic linework fills the sheet; headline and number sit beside it; licence, ABN and phone live in the drawing's title block.
options.risk: Turns into a cold blueprint if the drawing gets fussy or the copy goes technical. The house section has to be drawn with real craft.

raised.raise: One unbroken line: the sewer main runs the whole page from the house to the street, and a flow marker rides it to show where you are.
Line type carries the meaning, colour only confirms it: sewer heavy, stormwater dashed, gas broken with a G, hot red, cold blue.
Rank is drawing scale: the house at 1:100, each problem as an enlarged 1:10 detail, never a type ladder for its own sake.
Everything snaps to the sheet's border zones (A to F, 1 to 8) and every cross-reference cites its zone.
Every symbol carries a detail bubble that opens the real photo or flyer line behind it.

options.label: Signwritten Canopy
options.thesis: The site is signwritten like their own ute: the number at back-door scale on black canopy panels.
materials: cut vinyl on a black canopy
options.viewport: Their real ute, with the 24/7 badge cropped out, and the phone number running full width in the canopy's red bar.
options.risk: The most familiar route: lots of trade sites lean on vehicle-wrap graphics, and it can tip into flyer-loud.

options.label: Letterpress Trade Poster
options.thesis: Stacked wood type that names the problem and the number, in JK's own red and blue.
options.viewport: BLOCKED. LEAKING. GONE COLD. stacked full width, the number printed as the red pass.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and is the fastest read, but Macarthur homeowners don't know gig posters the way they know their own house plans.
options.risk: Off-register ink on poster stock can read rough or cheap, which you've ruled out.

options.label: Rhythm Machine Step Row
options.thesis: Services as sixteen lit step keys with a chase light running the row.
options.viewport: A row of problem keys, with the number in the tempo readout.
options.case: Fuses poorly: neither homeowners nor builders read plumbing through a drum machine.
options.kept: One unbroken line with a marker that always shows where you are.
options.risk: Novelty that gets between the visitor and the phone number.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Services as numbered lanes tied to defaults by amber link lines.
options.viewport: Numbered amber lanes on black glass, one per service.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it's an operations console, not something a stressed homeowner recognises.
options.kept: Meaning carried by line type, never by colour alone.
options.risk: Reads as software, cold and remote.

options.label: Copy-Shop Zine
options.thesis: A typed photocopied sheet, the heading blown up until it breaks.
options.viewport: One goldenrod sheet, a typed column, the number enlarged off the edge.
options.case: Works as a letterbox flyer but reads rough or cheap, which you've ruled out.
options.kept: Rank by magnification: details are enlarged views, never a type ladder.
options.risk: Looks cheap for a licensed trade.

options.label: Azulejo Station Hall
options.thesis: Narrative panels painted in cobalt straight across a tile grid.
options.viewport: A cobalt tiled bathroom scene with a cartouche for the number.
options.case: Tiles touch the bathroom work, but painted narrative is Lisbon, not Macarthur.
options.kept: Everything snaps to the sheet's grid zones and cross-references cite them.
options.risk: Decorative and foreign to the audience.

options.label: Punched Jacquard
options.thesis: Punched instruction rows weaving into a finished motif.
options.viewport: Instruction rows resolving into the logo in gold weft.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link to plumbing or to the people calling.
options.kept: Every symbol traces to its evidence through a detail bubble.
options.risk: Ornamental, with no product truth behind it.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean trades site: job-photo hero, big call button, services, areas, form, done at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A job photo behind the headline and a large call button, services underneath.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other plumber, by design.
